skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and apply ethical principles in business contexts, recognize and resolve ethical issues in business operations, and promote responsible business practices.
Understand and implement corporate social responsibility (CSR) principles, and develop CSR strategies for businesses.
Apply ethical decision-making frameworks in business scenarios.
Understand the role of social capital in business and how to build it.
Develop and implement ethical programs and codes of conduct in organizations.
Analyze ethical issues critically and propose effective solutions.
Understand and promote sustainable business practices.
Manage stakeholder relationships ethically and responsibly.
Demonstrate personal responsibility and leadership in promoting sustainable business practices.
